file.description: The file the listing is limited to, resolved through renames to its current path.

degreeGuideline.description: The degree percentage that pairs are marked against (cochange.minDegree, or --min-degree).

toleranceGuideline.description: Percentage points of degree within which a pair is stable between the two windows (cochange.couplingTrendTolerance).

asymmetry.description: Confidence percentages for asymmetric-coupling: one direction at least `high`, the other at most `low`.

population.description: The logical changes coupling was counted over.

eligibleChanges.description: Changes at or below the maximum changeset size: the one population behind every count.

oversizedExcluded.description: Changes above the maximum, left out on both sides of every ratio.

trendWindows.description: Present with --trend: the window before the current one, of the same length, that the pairs were compared with.

until.description: Exclusive: the start of the current window.

eligibleChanges.description: Zero means the trend of every pair is null.

note.description: Set when no pair reaches the support floor. The floor is never lowered.

path.description: The first file of the pair. With --file, the named file.

pathKind.description: Whether a language adapter or lexical profile claims `path`. Coupling includes the files that are not code, such as a lockfile that changes with its manifest, and labels them.

degree.description: Symmetric strength in percent: support over the mean of the two files' change counts.

aboveGuideline.description: Degree is at or above the degree guideline. Pairs under it are listed after the others.

confidence.description: Percent of changes to `path` that also touch `with`.

reverseConfidence.description: Percent of changes to `with` that also touch `path`.

support.description: Eligible logical changes touching both files.

distance.description: Folder-tree distance between the two files, as they are now.

previousDegree.description: With --trend: the pair's degree in the previous window, 0 when it shared no change there. Null when that window holds no eligible change.

previousSupport.description: With --trend: eligible changes touching both files in the previous window.

degreeChange.description: With --trend: the degree minus the previous degree, in percentage points, each rounded to one decimal first.

trend.description: With --trend: stronger or weaker when the degree moved by more than the tolerance, stable within it. Null when the previous window holds no eligible change.

dependent.description: With asymmetric-coupling, the file whose changes usually include the other. Otherwise null.

clearsMinimum.description: Support reaches the configured cochange.minSupport, whatever --min-support listed. False means low confidence.
